svg.title: Archived JoBatea onboarding, guidance, and search history v1 exploration
svg.desc: This intermediate low-fidelity design was superseded by the consolidated v1 workflow reference.
svg.text: Archived: onboarding, guidance, and history exploration
Superseded by the consolidated Deep Job Search workflow v1.
- Compact Search profile donut shows advisory completion and reveals details on hover or focus.
- A generated Prompt Guidance Sheet previews saved criteria plus optional Additional Context.
- Deep Job Search displays the latest three completed runs.
- A dedicated Search History screen exposes all immutable runs and their result sets.
- Repeated postings are suppressed unless authoritative source evidence shows a fresh posting.
The active reference integrates these decisions with prerequisite setup and returned results.
See ../deep-job-search-workflow-v1-low-fi.svg for the active low-fidelity handoff.
